prompt:
Character reference sheet, one wide image in two parts, photorealistic photograph. LEFT two-thirds: full-body turnaround of the same person, three views side by side at identical scale: front view, exact 90-degree side view, exact 180-degree back view, relaxed A-pose. RIGHT third: close-up head-and-shoulders portrait of the SAME person facing camera, mouth closed. Plain light-grey background, soft even studio light at a neutral white balance, no shadows, natural skin texture with pores, no text, no labels, no watermark.
The person: 纪宏远, a fictional 52-year-old, Ji Ran's father, a domineering businessman who arranges her marriages for profit. He appears only in the 'Five years earlier' flashback (scene 1-2). His age, appearance and wardrobe here are as he looks in that flashback.; the face, skin and build of exactly that age, which the role does not change. Appearance: As seen in the flashback five years before the present: an East Asian man of 52 with a broad, square face, heavy brows, deep nasolabial lines and a stern mouth. Short black hair, lightly greying at the temples, combed back neatly. About 175 cm tall with a solid, slightly thick-set build. He wears a gold signet ring and a gold watch.. Wearing one outfit only: In the flashback five years earlier, at the Ji family home: a tailored dark-brown wool suit jacket over a white dress shirt with no tie, matching dark-brown trousers and polished brown leather shoes.. Signature colour: brown. Expression in the close-up shows: Cold, imperious and mercenary. He treats his daughter as an asset and anyone beneath him with contempt.. The full-body views keep the body's build and proportions as the appearance gives them, head-to-body ratio included, never slimmer. Cast as a commercial live-action short drama: an adult lead (the heroine, the hero) or a young adult woman in a prominent role is a strikingly beautiful or handsome, camera-ready actor, with the figure, make-up, hair and fitted outfit the appearance and outfit give; a character under 18 looks and dresses like an ordinary child or teenager of that age and is never styled to look sexy; any other supporting role is an ordinary-looking person of that age.
The outfit is identical in every view and in the close-up: the same garments, accessories and details on the same side of the body, seen from that view's angle (an earring on the left ear stays on the left ear; a tie, a pocket square, gloves or hair ribbons are in every view or in none). Garments are plain, with no logo, brand mark, or printed letters or numbers.

Avoid: a different face between the views, an older-looking or younger-looking face than 52, doll-like face, a second outfit, extra people, extra limbs, text or labels.
